note: A REAL Bedrock run, 30 nodes / 25 receipt rows, and the most load-bearing fixture here. Three things only it has: rows that do NOT sum to the total in float64 (so a host summing floats fails on it — see #18); a model-spend residual, because reduce nodes spend with no model version; and 5 unfunded nodes, the cap-bound degradation that --fake cannot construct because its per-call cost is uniform. Exit 0: degradation is not a failure.
